request: Deploy exact prebuilt DebugAI PR112 paired app/sidecar through existing Host Compose project with four AI Core Gates; preserve old image IDs, live mounts/volumes and refuse unless Gate health passes.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; r=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai; p="$r/.worktrees/pr112-gates-20261016"; test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 23; test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain)" || exit 24; test -s /tmp/debugai-pr112-before-image-id.txt; test -s /tmp/debugai-pr112-before-sidecar-image-id.txt; c=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai); s=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=sandbox-runner); test -n "$c" && test -n "$s" || exit 31; proj=$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$c"); test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$s")" = "$proj" || exit 32; docker inspect -f '{{json .Mounts}}' "$c" | jq -S 'map({Type,Source,Destination,Name,RW})|sort_by(.Destination)' >/tmp/debugai-pr112-app-mounts-before.json; docker inspect -f '{{json .Mounts}}' "$s" | jq -S 'map({Type,Source,Destination,Name,RW})|sort_by(.Destination)' >/tmp/debugai-pr112-sidecar-mounts-before.json; for port in 18181 18182 18183 18184; do test "$(curl -s --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$port/health")" = 200 || exit 33; done; export DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE=model_gates DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_GRANITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18181 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_QWEN3_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18182 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_MINISTRAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18183 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_CODER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18184; timeout 120s docker compose -p "$proj" --env-file "$r/.env" -f "$p/compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build sandbox-runner debug-ai >/tmp/debugai-pr112-deploy.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 12 /tmp/debugai-pr112-deploy.log; exit 42; }
